title: The Last Static
author: Beatrix Zhou
blurb: Ulyana Thornbury, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
